title: 第十九章 人仙后期连载公告
lines: “不!我不锤了，你当我傻!”李磊揉着自己青的发紫的拳头怒声说道。
现在可倒好了，这铸魔洞窟是进也进不去，出也出不来，就算是李磊再着急也没有任何办法了。
索性，李磊不管了，躺在地上准备混吃等死。
“你就这样闲待一天吗，不干点什么事吗”石头问道。
“也对!要不咱俩玩几把井字游戏?我先画！”李磊兴奋的答道。
“滚!玩个头，有这时间不抓紧修炼!”
“哈哈哈，不用提醒，我正有此意，谁不知道我李磊自幼爱好读书，勤学苦练。”李磊尴尬的笑道。
很显然他着急出去把修炼这一档子事给忘了。
李磊从乾坤袋中掏出那本残破不堪的《死灵图》，以及能有助修炼的流邪葫芦，将它们放在地上便准备修炼。
“等等，你是要修炼功法还是要提升修为啊，怎么全都拿出来了”石头不解的问道。
“哦?不能一起修炼吗”
“能，但是很难，就凭你……”
“就凭我的悟性一定能做的到”李磊笑着说道。
“从未见过如此厚颜无耻之徒”石头倍感无语。
“好了，好了，我自己的情况难道我自己不清楚吗，我先试试再说吧”
说完李磊便盘膝而坐准备修炼，可是刚坐下没一会，李磊的目光又瞅向了那个流邪葫芦。
“内个葫芦怎么用啊!”李磊尴尬的笑道。
“呃……我以为你会呢，我的错，我的错”石头无奈叹道。
“你难道不知道法宝必须与人缔结认主之后才能使用吗”
“不知道”李磊摇了摇头。
“你气息融入法宝中，与它沟通融合，尽力而为就好，可能会花费很长时间，因为它毕竟是品质极好的……”
“好了!”李磊手里拿着葫芦晃了晃说道。
“行!准备好了那开始吧”
“不!我刚刚在你说话的间隙已经和流邪葫芦缔结融合完成了”李磊得意的说道。
“开玩笑，你有那能耐能一瞬间就将它认主了?好了，感紧开始吧”石头催促道。
李磊手持流邪葫芦，意念一动，忽然间流邪葫芦上面黑色符咒竟然运转开来，就连紫黑色气焰也是越发磅礴。
“什么，你竟然真的”石头大吃一惊。
“没错!我现在差不多掌握了这流邪葫芦的使用方法了，现在可以修炼了吧”李磊得意道。
说完李磊催动流邪葫芦，让流邪葫芦辅助李磊修炼，伴随着黑色符咒涌动，流邪葫芦竟然自主的飞了起来，瓶口对着李磊，瓶口中还散发出紫黑色光华将李磊笼罩。
李磊丝毫没有担忧顾及，因为通过和流邪融合认主后李磊几乎已经完全掌握了解这个葫芦的作用了，这就是流邪葫芦辅助修炼的方式没错了。
“想不到你小子还会活学活用”石头感叹道。
content_en:
"No! I won't hammer anymore, you think I'm stupid!" Li Lei said angrily, rubbing his blue and purple fists.
It's better now. It's impossible to get in or out of this Demon-casting Cave. No matter how anxious Li Lei is, there's nothing he can do.
Simply, Li Lei ignored it and lay on the ground ready to eat and wait to die.
"Are you just going to sit around like this all day and not do anything?" Shitou asked.
"That's right! How about we play a few games of tic-tac-toe? I'll draw first!" Li Lei replied excitedly.
"Go away! Just playing around, don't hurry up and practice while you have this time!"
"Hahaha, no need to remind me, that's what I meant. Who doesn't know that I, Li Lei, have been fond of reading since I was a child, and I study hard and practice hard." Li Lei said with an embarrassed smile.
It was obvious that he was so anxious to go out that he forgot about practicing.
Li Lei took out the dilapidated "Character of the Dead" and the evil-living gourd that could help him practice from his Qiankun bag, placed them on the ground and prepared to practice.
"Wait a minute, do you want to practice martial arts or improve your cultivation level? Why did you bring them all out?" Shitou asked in confusion.
"Oh? Can't we practice together?"
"You can, but it's difficult. It's up to you..."
"I can definitely do it with my understanding," Li Lei said with a smile.
"I have never seen such a shameless person." Shitou was speechless.
"Okay, okay, don't I know my own situation clearly? I'll try it first and then talk about it."
After saying that, Li Lei sat cross-legged and prepared to practice, but just after sitting down, Li Lei's eyes turned to the evil gourd again.
"What are you going to do with the gourd inside?" Li Lei said with an embarrassed smile.
"Uh... I thought you would, my fault, my fault," Shitou sighed helplessly.
"Don't you know that a magic weapon can only be used after it has been concluded with someone and recognizes its owner?"
"I don't know." Li Lei shook his head.
"Just integrate your breath into the magic weapon, communicate and integrate with it, and do your best. It may take a long time, because it is of excellent quality after all..."
"Okay!" Li Lei said, shaking the gourd in his hand.
"Okay! If you're ready, let's start."
"No! I just completed the fusion with Liuxie Gourd while you were talking," Li Lei said proudly.
"You're kidding, do you have the ability to recognize it as your master in an instant? Okay, let's start feeling tight," Shitou urged.
Li Lei held the Liuxie Gourd in his hand, and with a thought, the black talisman on the Liuxie Gourd suddenly started to operate, and even the purple-black arrogance became more and more majestic.
"What, you're serious?" Shitou was shocked.
"That's right! I have almost mastered how to use this evil gourd now. I can practice it now," Li Lei said proudly.
After speaking, Li Lei activated the Liuxie Gourd and asked the Liuxie Gourd to assist Li Lei in his practice. With the surge of black talismans, the Liuxie Gourd flew up on its own. The mouth of the bottle faced Li Lei, and the purple-black brilliance shrouded Li Lei in the bottle mouth.
Li Lei didn't worry at all, because after merging with Liu Xie and recognizing his master, Li Lei had almost fully understood the function of this gourd. This was definitely the way Liu Xie's gourd assisted cultivation.
"I didn't expect that you kid can still learn and apply it," Shitou sighed.
title_en: Chapter 19 Announcement of the later series of Immortals
